definition: frightened because you think you may get hurt or something bad may happen (afraid of + somebody/something/-ing)
exampleSentence: Many children are afraid of the dark.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều đứa trẻ sợ bóng tối.

definition: feeling strong emotions that make you want to shout at someone, about a situation (angry about + something)
exampleSentence: Kate is still so angry about the whole thing.
exampleTranslation: Kate vẫn còn rất tức giận về toàn bộ chuyện đó.

definition: feeling strong emotions that make you want to shout at someone, because of how you were treated (angry at + something)
exampleSentence: They are angry at the way they have been treated.
exampleTranslation: Họ tức giận vì cách họ bị đối xử.

definition: feeling strong emotions that make you want to shout at a person (angry with + somebody)
exampleSentence: Please don't be angry with me.
exampleTranslation: Xin đừng giận tôi.

definition: worried about something (anxious about + something)
exampleSentence: He was a bit anxious about the safety of the machinery.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy hơi lo lắng về độ an toàn của máy móc.

definition: feeling very sorry and embarrassed because of something you have done (ashamed of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: I felt ashamed of the things I'd said to him.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thấy xấu hổ về những điều đã nói với anh ấy.

definition: knowing or realizing that something exists or is happening (aware of + something)
translation: nhận thức được, biết về điều gì
exampleSentence: The children are aware of the danger of taking drugs.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ nhận thức được sự nguy hiểm của việc dùng ma túy.

definition: having no skill or ability in an activity (bad at + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: I'm really bad at chess.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chơi cờ vua rất tệ.

definition: tired and impatient because you do not find something interesting (bored with + something)
exampleSentence: Are you bored with your present job?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có chán công việc hiện tại không?

definition: having the qualities or ability needed to do something (capable of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: I don't think he's capable of murder.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không nghĩ anh ta có khả năng giết người.

definition: trying hard to avoid doing anything wrong, about a choice or habit (careful about + something)
exampleSentence: Mara was careful about what she ate.
exampleTranslation: Mara rất cẩn thận về những gì cô ấy ăn.

definition: trying hard to avoid damaging or losing something you handle (careful with + something)
exampleSentence: He was very careful with the coffee so as not to spill it.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy rất cẩn thận với tách cà phê để không làm đổ.

definition: confident and sure, without any doubts (certain about + something)
exampleSentence: Are you certain about that?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có chắc chắn về điều đó không?

definition: confident and sure, without any doubts (certain of + something)
exampleSentence: He was certain of it.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy chắc chắn về điều đó.

definition: skilful at doing a particular thing; especially British English (clever at + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: He was clever at finding bargains.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy rất khéo trong việc tìm đồ giá hời.

definition: not far from someone or something (close to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Susan sat on a chair close to the window.
exampleTranslation: Susan ngồi trên chiếc ghế gần cửa sổ.

definition: worried about something (concerned about + something)
exampleSentence: She is concerned about how little food I eat.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy lo ngại vì tôi ăn quá ít.

definition: involved in something or affected by it (concerned with + something)
translation: liên quan đến, quan tâm đến
exampleSentence: The book is concerned with children's education.
exampleTranslation: Cuốn sách này liên quan đến giáo dục trẻ em.

definition: sure that something will happen the way you want or expect (confident about + something)
exampleSentence: I feel quite confident about the future.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cảm thấy khá tự tin về tương lai.

definition: sure that something will happen the way you want or expect (confident of + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: The team is confident of winning the final.
exampleTranslation: Đội tin chắc sẽ thắng trận chung kết.

definition: if two facts or events are connected, there is some kind of link between them (connected with + something)
exampleSentence: These are problems connected with drug abuse.
exampleTranslation: Đây là những vấn đề liên quan đến lạm dụng ma túy.

definition: joined to something else or to a large system or network (connected to + something)
translation: được nối với, kết nối với
exampleSentence: The light is connected to a timer.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc đèn được nối với bộ hẹn giờ.

definition: liking someone very much, or very interested in something (crazy about + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Dan is crazy about football.
exampleTranslation: Dan mê bóng đá phát cuồng.

definition: wanting to know about something (curious about + something)
exampleSentence: He was curious about how she would react.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy tò mò xem cô ấy sẽ phản ứng thế nào.

definition: not like something or someone else (different from + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Our sons are very different from each other.
exampleTranslation: Hai con trai chúng tôi rất khác nhau.

definition: not like something or someone else; more common in British English (different to + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Her jacket is different to mine.
exampleTranslation: Áo khoác của cô ấy khác áo của tôi.

definition: unhappy because something you hoped for did not happen (disappointed about + something)
exampleSentence: She was disappointed about missing the concert.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thất vọng vì lỡ mất buổi hòa nhạc.

definition: unhappy because someone did not do what you hoped (disappointed in + somebody)
exampleSentence: I'm very disappointed in you.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất thất vọng về con.

definition: unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped (disappointed with + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Local residents were disappointed with the decision.
exampleTranslation: Người dân địa phương thất vọng với quyết định đó.

definition: not sure that something is true or right (doubtful about + something/-ing)
translation: nghi ngờ, không chắc về điều gì
exampleSentence: At first we were doubtful about employing Charlie.
exampleTranslation: Lúc đầu chúng tôi còn nghi ngờ về việc thuê Charlie.

definition: very keen and excited about something that is going to happen (eager for + something)
translation: háo hức mong đợi điều gì
exampleSentence: The fans were eager for a glimpse of the singer.
exampleTranslation: Người hâm mộ háo hức muốn thoáng thấy ca sĩ.

definition: feeling uncomfortable or nervous and worrying about what people think (embarrassed about + something)
translation: ngượng, xấu hổ về điều gì
exampleSentence: I felt embarrassed about how untidy the house was.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thấy ngượng vì nhà cửa bừa bộn.

definition: feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something (enthusiastic about + something)
translation: nhiệt tình, hào hứng về điều gì
exampleSentence: All the staff are enthusiastic about the project.
exampleTranslation: Tất cả nhân viên đều hào hứng với dự án.

definition: happy and interested because something good has happened or will happen (excited about + something)
exampleSentence: Maria is getting pretty excited about the wedding.
exampleTranslation: Maria đang khá phấn khích về đám cưới.

definition: having a good knowledge or understanding of something (familiar with + something)
translation: quen thuộc với, am hiểu về
exampleSentence: Are you familiar with this type of machine?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có quen với loại máy này không?

definition: known by many people for a particular thing (famous for + something)
exampleSentence: France is famous for its wine.
exampleTranslation: Pháp nổi tiếng vì rượu vang.

definition: annoyed or bored and wanting something to change; informal (fed up with + something)
exampleSentence: I'm really fed up with this constant rain.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chán ngấy cơn mưa triền miên này.

definition: liking someone or something very much (fond of + somebody/something)
exampleSentence: Joe is quite fond of her, isn't he?
exampleTranslation: Joe khá quý cô ấy, đúng không?

definition: behaving towards someone in a way that shows you like them (friendly to + somebody)
exampleSentence: The staff were very friendly to us.
exampleTranslation: Nhân viên rất thân thiện với chúng tôi.

definition: being friends with someone (friendly with + somebody)
exampleSentence: Betty is very friendly with the Jacksons.
exampleTranslation: Betty rất thân với gia đình Jackson.

definition: feeling afraid (frightened of + somebody/something/-ing)
exampleSentence: I was frightened of being left by myself in the house.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sợ bị bỏ lại một mình trong nhà.

definition: containing as much or as many things or people as possible (full of + something)
exampleSentence: The kitchen was full of smoke.
exampleTranslation: Căn bếp đầy khói.

definition: very angry about a situation (furious about + something)
exampleSentence: He was furious about the delay.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy giận dữ vì sự chậm trễ.

definition: very angry with a person (furious with + somebody)
exampleSentence: She was furious with herself for letting things get out of hand.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy giận bản thân vì để mọi chuyện vượt ngoài tầm kiểm soát.

definition: pleased and happy about something (glad about + something)
exampleSentence: She wasn't leaving after all. He was glad about that.
exampleTranslation: Rốt cuộc cô ấy không đi. Anh ấy vui mừng về điều đó.

definition: able to do something well (good at + something/-ing)
exampleSentence: Alex is very good at languages.
exampleTranslation: Alex rất giỏi ngoại ngữ.

definition: suitable or convenient for someone or something (good for + somebody/something/-ing)
exampleSentence: It's a good day for going to the beach.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay là ngày thích hợp để đi biển.

definition: kind and understanding about what other people need (good to + somebody)
exampleSentence: The company has always been good to me.
exampleTranslation: Công ty luôn đối xử tốt với tôi.

definition: feeling that you want to thank someone for something kind they did (grateful for + something)
exampleSentence: I'm so grateful for all your help.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất biết ơn vì tất cả sự giúp đỡ của bạn.

definition: feeling that you want to thank someone (grateful to + somebody)
exampleSentence: I am very grateful to everyone who wrote to me.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất biết ơn tất cả những ai đã viết thư cho tôi.
